assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

control_failures.control_label: dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: audit finding - permit to work records incomplete for PSV-4110

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on PSV-4110 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically managing corrosion and thinning findings. PSV-4110 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 12 July 2017 a planned critical control verification of PSV-4110 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy not effective.
